description: Get a section of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated (O.C.G.A.) — Georgia state law — by citation. "16-5-1" is murder; "44-7-34" is the security-deposit-return statute. Accepts natural citation forms: "16-5-1", "O.C.G.A. § 16-5-1", "Ga. Code Ann. § 16-5-1", "Code Section 16-5-1", "Title 16, Chapter 5, Section 1". Returns the current statutory text, status (active/repealed/reserved), the legislative/amendment history (the Acts that enacted and amended it), editor's notes and cross references, and every stored historical version when a section has more than one (e.g. a delayed effective date). Keyless. Use for "what does O.C.G.A. 16-5-1 say" or to check a Georgia statute a case or contract relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "16-5-1" or "O.C.G.A. § 44-7-34". Title-chapter-section; the title is the part before the first dash.
